access_route.text: the weir inspector adds the crew to her evening walk-round, signs everyone onto the clearance roster, and brings the whole party through the towpath gate on foot

cipher_form.text: Maren indexed by drawing: every entry is the part's own silhouette, so reading the index means matching outline to object

access_route.text: a gate key hung inside the hollow cap of the third towpath bollard, exactly where the drawn index says to look
the tide-gauge window's slip bolt lifts if you press the swollen corner of the frame while you slide it

curiosity.text: Maren's folding boxwood rule left on a stair ledge, its second joint dark where her thumb rode

hint_carrier.text: a hoist spanner chained at the stair head, its shaft scratched with the outlines of every fitting it is meant to turn

curiosity.text: a card drum on the study desk that still spins to any letter at a tap of its treadle

hint_carrier.text: Maren's fitting drawer, each spare nested in a cut pocket shaped exactly to it, so an empty pocket names the part that belongs there
from the safe end of the weir walk, low sun lays each moving arm flat on the whitewashed wall, one clean outline at a time

obstacle.text: the weed-slick sill walk across the weir head, crossed a shuffle at a time with one hand on the rail

curiosity.text: the sump chamber hands every word back doubled, so a name spoken at the ladder foot answers from the far wall

hint_carrier.text: the flood staff at the sump is graduated not in numbers but in small cut profiles, each mark the shape of the fitting that works at that level

remedy.text: a lock tally shaved thin off the bench's own scrap box makes a shim that lets the bound pin drop back into its seat

contents.text: the lock's original grant of passage in its oilcloth sleeve, signed by the river commissioners and never copied

loft_signature.text: every tool hung on its own painted outline along the workshop wall, with one hook empty and its outline still waiting

n_end_secret.mechanism: a card pinned beside the empty hook appoints whoever finds this workshop its next keeper, and the friends take the post

safeguard.text: the strongroom shelf rides on a counterweight, and lifting more than a satchel's worth off it swings a red-painted paddle out over the doorway that will not be pushed back

n_end_caught.mechanism: the shelf rises before they reach the door, and second thoughts have them mid-return when the inspector's evening round arrives, ledger open

n_end_library.mechanism: one ledger page carries a traced copy of Maren's drawn index, folded away to puzzle over at home

n_end_giveup.mechanism: a boot slips on the weed-slick sill early enough to turn the crossing into a calm, deliberate shuffle back, and the pull-back is the sound call

n_end_timeout.mechanism: the lock's closing horn carries up the weir before the guessed fitting seats, and the fit waits for another evening

n_end_stuck.mechanism: muscling the pin bends its linkage, and the puller its empty bracket plainly expects is a tool nobody brought tonight

n_end_hero.mechanism: the recovered gate fitting is entered in the settlement's collection and set out on the lock-house wall for anyone to see

n_end_keepsake.mechanism: the grant and the rest go back on the shelf exactly as found and into the ledger honestly, and only the small keepsake travels home with them
